I am an old woman farming here in Oromia, and I have worked this land for many years. For my maize plot, I will buy some DAP and urea from the cooperative like my neighbors do, because without fertilizer the maize does not give good cobs, but I cannot afford a full dose. I keep a few cattle, so I will carry manure from the kraal to the plot before the rains. I will use improved maize seed from the cooperative this year because the local variety gave poor yield last season, but I have no money for pesticides and no irrigation — I depend on the meher rains. My sons and I will do most of the work ourselves, and I will only hire a few people for weeding and harvest.
